observation.prior_gap: The exact ModelExecution/v1 -> InferenceReceipt/v4 component harness verified model execution from caller-constructed admitted observation/invocation maps even though the retained donor already defined HCU_MODEL_EXECUTION_ADMISSION_STORE/v1 for atomic admission inside the existing canonical MiniUnifiedDB.
observation.risk: A deterministic component harness could therefore demonstrate downstream provenance while bypassing the canonical invocation uniqueness/generation/rollback owner that the product path is intended to require.
observation.post_fusion_state: The retained PR810 positive component path now creates VerifiedModelExecution only through admit_and_verify_model_execution on an existing MiniUnifiedDB SQLite connection before feeding the exact receipt into InferenceReceipt/v4. Successor work has built further J-Space/v3 and concurrency closure on top of this same lineage.

hypothesis.claim: Routing the deterministic integration harness through the same MiniUnifiedDB atomic admission primitive used by the intended runtime boundary removes a false-positive class in which downstream Inference/v4 provenance is valid only against caller-supplied registry maps.
hypothesis.falsifier: An exact-source admitted Sandbox run of the fused capsule fails one of the six admission/inference fences, or successor integration demonstrates that the real executor path can still mint VerifiedModelExecution without the canonical admission transaction.

counterhypothesis.claim: The caller-supplied map harness was already sufficient because verify_model_execution checked equivalent values, so storage-level admission adds no meaningful causal guarantee.
counterhypothesis.discriminator: Divergent replay, stale-generation no-write and concurrent one-winner behavior require transactional persistence semantics that an ephemeral caller map does not establish. Successor regressions should preserve this distinction through J-Space/v3.
